notesHTML:
• The screen no longer dims or goes to sleep in the middle of a film. While a video plays (in the player or the mini player) Mezzanine keeps the Mac awake; paused, closed or casting to a TV, the Mac sleeps as usual.
  • Remote control from Plex apps is now off by default (Settings ▸ Playback): Plex's current iPhone and Android apps only cast to Google Cast devices, not to Plex players like Mezzanine.
